narrative.overview: SuperMonitor is an operator's instrument panel rather than a generic SaaS card wall. Graphite surfaces, etched separators, compact measurements, and scarce semantic signal colors make freshness, quota pressure, and source confidence readable at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite tonal layering with fine structural borders.
Semantic cyan, amber, coral, and green signals.
Fast state-driven motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Cyan is reserved for live state, selection, and the primary action; it must not become general decoration.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where alignment or numeric scanning materially improves comprehension.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Resting content panels use borders and tonal contrast; shadows are reserved for overlays and transient elevation.

dos: Do preserve provider-native units and show source and freshness beside the value.
Do use semantic status color together with text, icons, or placement.
Do keep routine transitions fast, interruptible, and transform-based.
Do test the 224px rail, 76px rail, and mobile bottom-dock compositions.
donts: Don't replace the chart-first hierarchy with a generic grid of equal cards.
Don't mix credits, currency, token plans, and time-window limits into one score.
Don't use cyan as ambient decoration or coral without a recovery path.
Don't add proxy-routing, account-rotation, or model-request controls to this product surface.
